ar.title: تجهيزات الفراخ لرمضان
ar.intro: يمكن حفظ التتبيلات والفراخ في الفريزر لمدة شهر أو شهرين. عند استخدامها، اتركها لتذوب قبل الطهي. يمكن طهي الفراخ المشوية على الجريل أو في الفرن أو على الطاسة. يمكن طهي الكفتة على الطاسة أو الفحم للحصول على أفضل نتيجة.

en.title: Chicken Prep-Ahead Marinades for Ramadan
en.intro: The marinades and chicken keep in the freezer for a month or two. Thaw before cooking — grilled chicken on a grill pan, in the oven, or in a pan; kofta on a pan or over charcoal for best results.

steps.n2: Mix all the following in a bowl: onion juice, orange juice, vinegar, oil, ketchup, thyme, dried coriander, salt, black pepper, onion powder, garlic powder, turmeric, chili, Chinese five-spice, sugar or honey, and soy sauce.
steps.n4: Wash the chicken and cut it as desired.
steps.n5: Place the chicken in the marinade and toss well.
steps.n6: Store the chicken in the freezer in separate bags.
steps.n8: Mix the yogurt, ketchup or hot sauce, onion powder, cardamom, garlic powder, dried coriander, chicken spices, salt, and pepper in a bowl.
steps.n10: Wash the chicken breasts and drain well.
steps.n11: Place the chicken breasts in the marinade and toss well.
steps.n12: In another bowl, mix the ground breadcrumbs, flour, starch, onion powder, garlic powder, salt, pepper, and spices.
steps.n13: Dip the chicken pieces in the marinade, then in the breadcrumb mixture.
steps.n14: Store in the freezer in separate bags with separators between the pieces.
steps.n16: Mix the onion, garlic, parsley, bulgur, sugar, baking powder, salt, pepper, paprika, dried coriander, chicken spices, thyme, onion powder, and garlic powder in a bowl.
steps.n18: Shape the kofta into fingers or onto skewers.
steps.n19: Store the kofta in the freezer in separate bags with separators between the pieces.

legacySteps: Preparing the grilled chicken marinade:

Mix all the following in a bowl: onion juice, orange juice, vinegar, oil, ketchup, thyme, dried coriander, salt, black pepper, onion powder, garlic powder, turmeric, chili, Chinese five-spice, sugar or honey, and soy sauce.
Mix well until combined.
Wash the chicken and cut it as desired.
Place the chicken in the marinade and toss well.
Store the chicken in the freezer in separate bags.
Preparing the paneed chicken breasts:
Mix the yogurt, ketchup or hot sauce, onion powder, cardamom, garlic powder, dried coriander, chicken spices, salt, and pepper in a bowl.
Mix well until combined.
Wash the chicken breasts and drain well.
Place the chicken breasts in the marinade and toss well.
In another bowl, mix the ground breadcrumbs, flour, starch, onion powder, garlic powder, salt, pepper, and spices.
Dip the chicken pieces in the marinade, then in the breadcrumb mixture.
Store in the freezer in separate bags with separators between the pieces.
Preparing the grilled chicken kofta:
Mix the onion, garlic, parsley, bulgur, sugar, baking powder, salt, pepper, paprika, dried coriander, chicken spices, thyme, onion powder, and garlic powder in a bowl.
Mix well until combined.
Shape the kofta into fingers or onto skewers.
Store the kofta in the freezer in separate bags with separators between the pieces.
